basic.description:
{Basic Artillery}

 Gives the hero control of the Ballista, Arrow Towers, and the Cannon. The Ballista has a 50% chance to inflict 200% base Damage. The Cannon has an increased chance to hit fortifications. Health points of the Ballista and Cannon are increased by 50.

advanced.description:
{Advanced Artillery}

 Gives the hero control of the Ballista, Arrow Towers, and the Cannon. The Ballista shoots twice and has a 75% chance to inflict 200% base Damage. The Cannon has an increased chance to hit fortifications and inflicts 200% base Damage to creatures. Health points of the Ballista and Cannon are increased by 100.

expert.description:
{Expert Artillery}

 Gives the hero control of the Ballista, Arrow Towers, and the Cannon. The Ballista shoots twice and inflicts 200% base Damage. The Cannon precisely hits fortifications at maximum Damage and inflicts 300% base Damage to creatures. Health points of the Ballista and Cannon are increased by 150.
